en.headline: H5 avian flu virus detected in two Mai Po Nature Reserve samples
en.dek: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said University of Hong Kong researchers confirmed the highly pathogenic virus in environmental samples collected on Wednesday.
body: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department was notified on Thursday by the University of Hong Kong that two environmental samples from the Mai Po Nature Reserve tested positive for the H5 highly pathogenic avian influenza virus.

A research team from the university’s School of Public Health regularly collects samples at the reserve in collaboration with the department for avian influenza surveillance. The two positive samples were collected on 11 November.

An AFCD spokesman said the World Wide Fund for Nature Hong Kong, which assists in managing the reserve, has stepped up cleaning and disinfection of visitor facilities including bird hides and the floating boardwalk. Disinfection mats have been placed at the entrance for visitors to clean the soles of their shoes. The department is closely monitoring birds in the reserve and has posted notices reminding the public to maintain personal hygiene.

There are no chicken farms within three kilometres of the sample collection sites. The AFCD has strengthened surveillance of local poultry farms and the wholesale market, and continues to remind poultry farmers, pet bird shop owners and bird exhibition licence holders to take appropriate precautions against avian influenza.

zh.headline: 米埔自然護理區兩環境樣本驗出H5高致病性禽流感病毒
zh.dek: 漁護署表示，香港大學研究團隊確認周三收集的環境樣本帶有H5病毒。
body: 漁農自然護理署周四接獲香港大學通知，兩個從米埔自然護理區收集的環境樣本驗出H5高致病性禽流感病毒。
港大公共衞生學院研究團隊與漁護署合作，定期進入護理區收集樣本作禽流感監測。兩個陽性樣本於11月11日收集。
漁護署發言人表示，協助管理護理區的世界自然基金會香港分會已加強清潔及消毒觀鳥屋及浮橋等遊客設施，並在入口設置消毒地墊供訪客清潔鞋底。署方正密切監察區內雀鳥情況，並張貼告示提醒市民注意個人衞生。
收集樣本地點三公里範圍內沒有雞場。漁護署已加強對本地活家禽農場及批發市場的監察，並持續提醒家禽農戶、雀鳥店主及禽鳥展覽牌照持有人採取適當預防措施。
